title: Emergency Procedures
content:
ORION NanoFab Documentation
SUPERUSER ONLY

Emergency Procedures

ZEISS states EMO buttons are only for an actual emergency requiring immediate removal of microscope electrical power. EMO shutdown can cause data loss and may damage turbo pumps; do not use it for normal shutdown.
